name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.notifications.AppConnectNotificationReceiver
description: When a Dataroid AppConnect notification is opened, dismissed, or one of its buttons is tapped, this receiver records the interaction and carries out the linked or custom action.
disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect notification taps, buttons, and dismissals will no longer be handled, so notification links or custom actions may not open.
